title: Drain deadline with an unanswered VFS_RESYNC enters Failed with path and mseq

preconditions.notes: The Worker is connected but never answers the outstanding VFS_RESYNC for /dsh/workspace/notes.txt mseq 2; the 20 s drain deadline expires.

timeline.detail: admission closes; the drain waits for the outstanding VFS_RESYNC at /dsh/workspace/notes.txt mseq 2

timeline.event: drain deadline elapses; the VFS_RESYNC is still unanswered
timeline.detail: the completed epoch close cannot repair the held append, so the close fails and admission closes with the mismatch path and mseq
the failure detail names /dsh/workspace/notes.txt mseq 2; no epoch-close record is invented

notes: This fixture is the negative half of the drain wait: a missing answer by the deadline is the existing wal.md section 5.2 failure, now with the path and mseq named. The runner must read the recorded failure detail, not just the terminal state, and must not append a close record to turn the open epoch into a closed one.
